items.name: Aggregate firm contract backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: Flex LNG's aggregate firm contract backlog for the fleet is 51 years based on the earliest charter expirations, which could increase to 78 years if charterers exercise all contracted extension options.
items.source_excerpt: the aggregate firm contract backlog for the Fleet is 51 years based on the earliest charter expirations, which could increase to 78 years if our charterers exercise all of the contracted extension options.

items.name: 15-year time charter for Flex Constellation
items.claim: Flex LNG agreed a new 15-year Time Charter Agreement for Flex Constellation, with commencement in the first or second quarter of 2026, maturity in 2041, and an extension option until 2043.
items.source_excerpt: Flex LNG Ltd (“Flex LNG” or the “Company”) (NYSE/OSE: FLNG) is pleased to announce it has agreed a new Time Charter Agreement (“TC”) for Flex Constellation for 15-years. Commencement of the charter will occur during the first or second quarter of 2026 with maturity in 2041. The TC also include an extension option for the charterer until 2043.

notes: The current fleet-wide backlog figure (51 years firm / 78 years with extensions) is from the stored Q2 2026 6-K (data/edgar/docs/FLNG.json), filed 2026-08-19 and current as of the report date. The Flex Constellation 15-year TC (data/web/99a305e67de4a04e.json, a November 2024 press release still on flexlng.com) is one of the named contracts underlying that current backlog figure. A second fetched press release (data/web/54885b5eba7f22ee.json, June 2022, three vessels/$750m) is older news superseded by the current backlog figure and not cited as a separate item to avoid double counting.
